fields.areaDesc: Haldane County, OH; Marlow County, OH
fields.headline: Flash Flood Warning for Haldane and Marlow Counties until 5:15 PM
fields.description: At 2:13 PM EDT, radar and rain gauges show thunderstorms producing heavy rain. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly. Cedar Ridge Reservoir is near its spillway crest.
fields.instruction: Move to higher ground now. Turn around, do not drown: do not drive through flooded roads.
fields.cmamText: EXERCISE Flash Flood Warning in your area until 5:15 PM. Move to higher ground. -RCEM
fields.cmamLongText: EXERCISE Flash Flood Warning for Haldane and Marlow Counties until 5:15 PM EDT. Flooding is ongoing near Cedar Ridge Reservoir. Move to higher ground now and do not drive through flooded roads. Rook County Emergency Management.
